class_name Rocket extends Area3D
## Straight-flying rocket; explodes on contact with world or enemies.
## ponytail: transform-stepped Area at 60 m/s can tunnel thin walls (<0.3 m);
## switch to a raycast-per-step or RigidBody+CCD if that matters in game/.

var vel := Vector3.ZERO
var shooter: Node
var dmg := 46.0
var aoe_radius := 4.5
var aoe_dmg := 32.0

var _life := 6.0
var _armed := false     # ignore the shooter's own hull for the first ticks
var _exploded := false


static func spawn(parent: Node, from: Vector3, dir: Vector3, speed: float,
		shooter: Node, dmg_v: float, aoe_r: float, aoe_d: float) -> Rocket:
	var r := Rocket.new()
	r.vel = dir * speed
	r.shooter = shooter
	r.dmg = dmg_v
	r.aoe_radius = aoe_r
	r.aoe_dmg = aoe_d
	parent.add_child(r)
	r.global_position = from
	return r


func _ready() -> void:
	collision_layer = 8
	collision_mask = 1 | 4 | 2
	monitoring = true
	var col := CollisionShape3D.new()
	var s := SphereShape3D.new()
	s.radius = 0.22
	col.shape = s
	add_child(col)
	var mi := MeshInstance3D.new()
	var mesh := CylinderMesh.new()
	mesh.top_radius = 0.09
	mesh.bottom_radius = 0.09
	mesh.height = 0.45
	mi.mesh = mesh
	mi.rotation.x = deg_to_rad(90)   # cylinder axis along travel (-Z)
	var mat := StandardMaterial3D.new()
	mat.albedo_color = Color(0.85, 0.8, 0.7)
	mat.emission_enabled = true
	mat.emission = Color(1.0, 0.55, 0.2)
	mi.material_override = mat
	add_child(mi)
	body_entered.connect(_on_body)
	# Arm after leaving the muzzle sphere.
	get_tree().create_timer(0.06).timeout.connect(func() -> void: _armed = true)


func _physics_process(dt: float) -> void:
	global_position += vel * dt
	_life -= dt
	if _life <= 0.0:
		queue_free()
		return
	# Proximity fuse: detonate when passing near any enemy.
	var params := PhysicsShapeQueryParameters3D.new()
	var s := SphereShape3D.new()
	s.radius = 1.0
	params.shape = s
	params.transform = Transform3D(Basis.IDENTITY, global_position)
	params.collision_mask = 4
	if shooter is CollisionObject3D:
		params.exclude = [shooter.get_rid()]
	if not get_world_3d().direct_space_state.intersect_shape(params, 4).is_empty():
		_explode()


func _on_body(body: Node3D) -> void:
	if _exploded:
		return
	if not _armed and body == shooter:
		return
	_explode()


func _explode() -> void:
	if _exploded or not is_inside_tree():
		return
	_exploded = true
	var pos := global_position
	var parent := get_parent()
	set_deferred("monitoring", false)
	# AOE over enemies only - prototype has no friendly fire.
	var params := PhysicsShapeQueryParameters3D.new()
	var sphere := SphereShape3D.new()
	sphere.radius = aoe_radius
	params.shape = sphere
	params.transform = Transform3D(Basis.IDENTITY, pos)
	params.collision_mask = 4
	if shooter is CollisionObject3D:
		params.exclude = [shooter.get_rid()]
	for hit in get_world_3d().direct_space_state.intersect_shape(params, 32):
		var n := hit.collider as Node
		if n == null or not is_instance_valid(n):
			continue
		# Armored bonus is applied inside DummyEnemy.take_damage by source.
		ActorIface.apply_damage(n, ActorIface.make_damage(aoe_dmg,
				ActorIface.Source.MECH_ROCKET, 0, pos,
				(pos - n.global_position).normalized()))
	Fx.explosion(parent, pos)
	Fx.play_sfx(parent, Fx.boom_stream(), 0.0, randf_range(0.85, 1.1))
	queue_free()

class_name SimKit extends Object
## Assembles the whole VS6 sandbox (arena + pilot + mech + core) so manual
## play, unit tests and scenarios share one wiring. Callers attach whichever
## command source they need: InputSource (human) or BotDriver (scripted).


static func assemble(root: Node, with_mech := true) -> Dictionary:
	var info := ArenaBuilder.build(root)

	var pilot := PilotController.new()
	pilot.name = "Pilot"
	root.add_child(pilot)
	pilot.global_position = info.pilot_spawn
	pilot.yaw = PI   # face the lanes (+Z)
	pilot.add_to_group("actors")
	pilot.cam().current = true   # pilot is the initial active role

	var kit := {"info": info, "pilot": pilot, "mech": null}

	if with_mech:
		var mech := MechController.new()
		mech.name = "Mech"
		root.add_child(mech)
		mech.global_position = info.pad_pos
		mech.yaw = PI
		mech.add_to_group("actors")
		kit["mech"] = mech

	return kit


## Damage routing helper honoring the "self or Health child" convention.
static func damage_target(node: Node, evt: Dictionary) -> void:
	if node.has_method("take_damage"):
		ActorIface.apply_damage(node, evt)
	else:
		var h := node.get_node_or_null("Health") as Node
		ActorIface.apply_damage(h, evt)


static func empty_command_frame(controller: Node, dt: float) -> void:
	if controller != null and controller.has_method("apply_command"):
		controller.apply_command(ActorIface.empty_command(), dt)

class_name TurretCC extends StaticBody3D
## VS-7 turret stub: CC / control. Pulses a slow field every 4 s — enemies
## inside the radius get slowed (speed ×0.45 for 2.5 s). Low lethality.

const RANGE := 9.0
const PULSE_GAP := 4.0
const SLOW_MULT := 0.45
const SLOW_TIME := 2.5

var _pulse_t := 1.0
var _ring: MeshInstance3D


func _ready() -> void:
	collision_layer = 1
	collision_mask = 0
	var base := MeshInstance3D.new()
	var bm := CylinderMesh.new()
	bm.top_radius = 0.4
	bm.bottom_radius = 0.6
	bm.height = 1.2
	base.mesh = bm
	base.position = Vector3(0, 0.6, 0)
	add_child(base)
	var crystal := MeshInstance3D.new()
	var cm := SphereMesh.new()
	cm.radius = 0.3
	cm.height = 0.6
	crystal.mesh = cm
	crystal.position = Vector3(0, 1.4, 0)
	var cm2 := StandardMaterial3D.new()
	cm2.albedo_color = Color(0.5, 0.3, 1.0)
	cm2.emission_enabled = true
	cm2.emission = Color(0.5, 0.3, 1.0)
	cm2.emission_energy_multiplier = 1.5
	crystal.material_override = cm2
	add_child(crystal)
	_ring = MeshInstance3D.new()
	var rm := TorusMesh.new()
	rm.inner_radius = RANGE - 0.15
	rm.outer_radius = RANGE + 0.15
	rm.rings = 32
	_ring.mesh = rm
	_ring.visible = false
	var rmat := StandardMaterial3D.new()
	rmat.albedo_color = Color(0.6, 0.3, 1.0)
	rmat.emission_enabled = true
	rmat.emission = Color(0.6, 0.3, 1.0)
	rmat.shading_mode = BaseMaterial3D.SHADING_MODE_UNSHADED
	_ring.material_override = rmat
	add_child(_ring)
	var col := CollisionShape3D.new()
	var cs := CylinderShape3D.new()
	cs.radius = 0.6
	cs.height = 1.6
	col.shape = cs
	col.position = Vector3(0, 0.8, 0)
	add_child(col)


func _physics_process(dt: float) -> void:
	_pulse_t -= dt
	if _pulse_t > 0.0:
		return
	_pulse_t = PULSE_GAP
	_ring.visible = true
	var tw := create_tween()
	tw.tween_property(_ring, "transparency", 1.0, 0.6).from(0.0)
	tw.tween_callback(func() -> void: _ring.visible = false)
	Fx.play_sfx(self, Fx.zap_stream(), -8.0, randf_range(0.9, 1.1))
	for e in get_tree().get_nodes_in_group("enemies"):
		var en := e as Node3D
		if en == null or not is_instance_valid(en):
			continue
		if en.global_position.distance_to(global_position) > RANGE:
			continue
		# CC slow: the enemy motor reads the "slowed_until" timestamp.
		en.set_meta("slowed_until", Time.get_ticks_msec() + int(SLOW_TIME * 1000))
		ActorIface.apply_damage(en, ActorIface.make_damage(2,
				ActorIface.Source.CC_TURRET, 0,
				en.global_position + Vector3.UP, Vector3.ZERO))

class_name TurretMG extends StaticBody3D
## VS-7 turret stub: MG / sustained DPS. Auto-fires the nearest enemy in
## range with hitscan bolts; limited ammo, no reload (supply = VS-8 scope).

const RANGE := 26.0
const DPS := 14.0
const SHOT_DMG := 7.0
const AMMO_MAX := 150

var ammo := AMMO_MAX
var _cd := 0.0
var _head: Node3D
var _muzzle: Marker3D


func _ready() -> void:
	collision_layer = 1
	collision_mask = 0
	# Base pedestal + rotating head with a barrel (readable silhouette).
	var base := MeshInstance3D.new()
	var bm := CylinderMesh.new()
	bm.top_radius = 0.5
	bm.bottom_radius = 0.7
	bm.height = 1.0
	base.mesh = bm
	base.position = Vector3(0, 0.5, 0)
	add_child(base)
	_head = Node3D.new()
	_head.position = Vector3(0, 1.2, 0)
	add_child(_head)
	var barrel := MeshInstance3D.new()
	var bx := BoxMesh.new()
	bx.size = Vector3(0.22, 0.22, 1.6)
	barrel.mesh = bx
	barrel.position = Vector3(0, 0.1, -0.8)
	_head.add_child(barrel)
	var col := CollisionShape3D.new()
	var cs := CylinderShape3D.new()
	cs.radius = 0.7
	cs.height = 1.6
	col.shape = cs
	col.position = Vector3(0, 0.8, 0)
	add_child(col)
	_muzzle = Marker3D.new()
	_muzzle.position = Vector3(0, 0.1, -1.6)
	_head.add_child(_muzzle)


func _physics_process(dt: float) -> void:
	_cd -= dt
	if ammo <= 0:
		return
	var target: Node3D = null
	var best := RANGE * RANGE
	for e in get_tree().get_nodes_in_group("enemies"):
		var en := e as Node3D
		if en == null or not is_instance_valid(en):
			continue
		var h := en.get_node_or_null("Health") as Health
		if h != null and h.state == ActorIface.ActorState.DESTROYED:
			continue
		var d := en.global_position.distance_squared_to(global_position)
		if d < best:
			best = d
			target = en
	if target == null:
		return
	# Track + fire.
	var to := target.global_position + Vector3.UP * 1.0 - _head.global_position
	_head.look_at(to + _head.global_position, Vector3.UP)
	if _cd > 0.0:
		return
	_cd = SHOT_DMG / DPS
	ammo -= 1
	var from := _muzzle.global_position
	var dir := (to).normalized()
	var query := PhysicsRayQueryParameters3D.create(from, from + dir * RANGE,
			1 | 4, [get_rid()])
	var hit := get_world_3d().direct_space_state.intersect_ray(query)
	var end := from + dir * RANGE
	if hit:
		end = hit.position as Vector3
		ActorIface.apply_damage(hit.collider as Node,
				ActorIface.make_damage(SHOT_DMG, ActorIface.Source.MG_TURRET,
						0, end, dir))
	Fx.tracer(self, from, end, Color(0.6, 0.9, 1.0), 200.0)

﻿class_name WaveDirector extends Node
## VS-7: three authored waves (Doctrine в†’ Complication в†’ Breakdown) over the
## arena contract. Data-driven pods (time/lane/composition); KPI per wave
## (core damage, kills by source, leaks, duration). Intermission 8 s.

signal wave_started(idx: int, def: Dictionary)
signal wave_ended(idx: int, kpi: Dictionary)
signal all_waves_done(results: Array)
signal greed_changed(greedy: bool)
signal extraction_started(seconds: int)
signal mission_ended(victory: bool, ex_banked: float)

## VS-8: EX + SAFE/GREEDY. The drill banks EX while waves pressure the core.
## GREEDY: faster drill, denser spawns. After W3 — extraction window: stay
## greedy for the bonus wave (more EX, more risk) or bank and end the op.
const INTERMISSION := 8.0
const EX_DRILL_SAFE := 1.2
const EX_DRILL_GREEDY := 1.7
const SPAWN_GREEDY_MULT := 0.75   # denser spawns while greedy
const SPAWN_SAFE_MULT := 1.3
const BONUS_WAVE := 3             # W4 index (0-based) — the greed bait

## Authored waves (VS-7 contract) + W4 bonus (greed bait, denser):
## W1 Doctrine — pressure only, alternating lanes, teaches lane holding.
## W2 Complication — armored priority + harassers + a heavier re-push.
## W3 Breakdown — all roles + Lane C opens + highest density.
## W4 Bonus — greed bait: denser mixed push for extra EX (extraction window).
const WAVES := [
	{
		"name": "W1_Doctrine", "duration": 42.0,
		"pods": [
			{"t": 2.0, "lane": "A", "comp": ["pressure", "pressure", "pressure", "pressure"]},
			{"t": 12.0, "lane": "B", "comp": ["pressure", "pressure", "pressure", "pressure"]},
			{"t": 22.0, "lane": "A", "comp": ["pressure", "pressure", "pressure", "pressure"]},
			{"t": 32.0, "lane": "B", "comp": ["pressure", "pressure", "pressure", "pressure"]},
		],
	},
	{
		"name": "W2_Complication", "duration": 52.0,
		"pods": [
			{"t": 2.0, "lane": "A", "comp": ["pressure", "pressure", "armored"]},
			{"t": 12.0, "lane": "B", "comp": ["harasser", "harasser", "pressure", "pressure"]},
			{"t": 20.0, "lane": "A", "comp": ["pressure", "pressure", "pressure", "armored"]},
			{"t": 30.0, "lane": "B", "comp": ["harasser", "pressure", "armored"]},
			{"t": 40.0, "lane": "A", "comp": ["pressure", "pressure", "pressure"]},
		],
	},
	{
		"name": "W3_Breakdown", "duration": 62.0,
		"pods": [
			{"t": 2.0, "lane": "A", "comp": ["pressure", "pressure", "armored", "pressure"]},
			{"t": 8.0, "lane": "C", "comp": ["harasser", "harasser"]},
			{"t": 14.0, "lane": "B", "comp": ["pressure", "armored", "pressure", "harasser"]},
			{"t": 22.0, "lane": "C", "comp": ["harasser", "harasser", "armored"]},
			{"t": 30.0, "lane": "A", "comp": ["pressure", "pressure", "pressure", "armored", "pressure"]},
			{"t": 40.0, "lane": "B", "comp": ["armored", "pressure", "pressure"]},
			{"t": 48.0, "lane": "C", "comp": ["harasser", "pressure", "pressure"]},
		],
	},
	{	# W4 — greed bait (extraction window): dense mixed push for extra EX.
		"name": "W4_Bonus_Greed", "duration": 40.0,
		"pods": [
			{"t": 2.0, "lane": "A", "comp": ["pressure", "armored", "pressure", "harasser"]},
			{"t": 10.0, "lane": "B", "comp": ["pressure", "pressure", "armored"]},
			{"t": 18.0, "lane": "C", "comp": ["harasser", "harasser", "pressure"]},
			{"t": 26.0, "lane": "A", "comp": ["armored", "pressure", "pressure", "pressure"]},
		],
	},
]

var world: Node3D
var info: Dictionary
var core: Node3D
var enabled := false

var t := 0.0
var wave_idx := -1
var pending_idx := 0
var wave_t := 0.0
var inter_t := INTERMISSION

## VS-8: EX + SAFE/GREEDY state.
var greedy := false
var ex_banked := 0.0
var extraction_window := false
var window_t := 0.0
const WINDOW_LEN := 20.0
signal ex_changed(ex: float)
var pod_i := 0
var _kpi := {}
var _kpi_core_hp0 := 0.0
var _kpi_kills := {}
var _kpi_leaked := 0
var _tracked: Array = []
var results: Array = []
var _core_lamp: OmniLight3D
var rng := RandomNumberGenerator.new()


func _ready() -> void:
	rng.seed = 77


func start(p_world: Node3D, p_info: Dictionary) -> void:
	world = p_world
	info = p_info
	core = info.core
	enabled = true
	t = 0.0
	wave_idx = -1
	inter_t = INTERMISSION
	results = []


func _physics_process(dt: float) -> void:
	if not enabled:
		return
	t += dt
	# EX drill (VS-8): banks while the op runs and the core stands.
	if core.get_node("Health").state != ActorIface.ActorState.DESTROYED:
		ex_banked += (EX_DRILL_GREEDY if greedy else EX_DRILL_SAFE) * dt
		ex_changed.emit(ex_banked)
		# Drill pulse on the core lamp (visual tie-in).
		if _core_lamp != null:
			_core_lamp.light_energy = 40.0 + 10.0 * sin(t * 4.0)

	if InputMap.has_action("toggle_greed") and Input.is_action_just_pressed("toggle_greed") \
			and not extraction_window:
		set_greed(not greedy)

	if wave_idx >= 0:
		wave_t += dt
		_spawn_due_pods()
		if wave_t >= float(WAVES[wave_idx].duration):
			_end_wave()
		elif core.get_node("Health").state == ActorIface.ActorState.DESTROYED:
			_end_wave(true)
			_finish(false)   # core lost: mission fails, EX is lost
			return
	elif pending_idx < WAVES.size():
		inter_t -= dt
		if inter_t <= 0.0:
			_start_wave(pending_idx)
			pending_idx += 1
	elif not extraction_window and pending_idx == BONUS_WAVE:
		# W3 done: extraction window. Greedy at expiry = bonus wave (risk).
		extraction_window = true
		window_t = WINDOW_LEN
		extraction_started.emit(WINDOW_LEN)
	elif extraction_window:
		window_t -= dt
		if Input.is_action_just_pressed("toggle_greed"):
			set_greed(not greedy)
		if window_t <= 0.0:
			extraction_window = false
			if greedy:
				set_greed(true)   # bonus wave runs greedy-forced
				inter_t = 4.0
			else:
				_finish(true)
	elif pending_idx == WAVES.size():
		_finish(true)


## Op end: victory (extracted) or core lost. Final KPI gets EX + mode.
func _finish(victory: bool) -> void:
	enabled = false
	extraction_window = false
	if results.size() > 0:
		var kpi: Dictionary = results[results.size() - 1]
		kpi["ex_banked"] = 0.0 if not victory else snappedf(ex_banked, 0.1)
		kpi["final_mode"] = "greedy" if greedy else "safe"
		kpi["victory"] = victory
	mission_ended.emit(victory, ex_banked if victory else 0.0)
	all_waves_done.emit(results)


func set_greed(on: bool) -> void:
	greedy = on
	greed_changed.emit(on)


func _start_wave(idx: int) -> void:
	if idx >= WAVES.size():
		enabled = false
		wave_started.emit(WAVES.size(), {"name": "DONE"})
		all_waves_done.emit(results)
		return
	wave_idx = idx
	wave_t = 0.0
	pod_i = 0
	_kpi = {"name": WAVES[idx].name, "core_hp_lost": 0, "duration_s": 0.0,
			"kills_by_source": {}, "leaked": 0, "spawned": 0}
	_kpi_core_hp0 = core.get_node("Health").hp
	_kpi_kills = {}
	_kpi_leaked = 0
	_tracked = []
	wave_started.emit(idx, WAVES[idx])
	print("WAVES wave_started %s" % WAVES[idx].name)


func _end_wave(core_lost := false) -> void:
	var kpi := _kpi.duplicate()
	kpi.core_hp_lost = int(_kpi_core_hp0 - core.get_node("Health").hp)
	kpi.duration_s = snappedf(wave_t, 0.1)
	kpi.kills_by_source = _kpi_kills.duplicate()
	kpi.leaked = _kpi_leaked
	kpi.core_lost = core_lost
	# Inter-wave repair: +60 hull (drones), never above max — the breather
	# between waves also repairs a chunk of the pressure damage.
	if not core_lost:
		var ch := core.get_node("Health") as Health
		ch.hp = minf(ch.hp + 60.0, ch.max_hp)
	kpi.core_repaired = 60 if not core_lost else 0
	results.append(kpi)
	wave_ended.emit(wave_idx, kpi)
	print("WAVES wave_ended %s core_lost=%d kills=%s" % [kpi.name,
			kpi.core_hp_lost, str(kpi.kills_by_source)])
	wave_idx = -1
	inter_t = INTERMISSION


func _spawn_due_pods() -> void:
	var def: Dictionary = WAVES[wave_idx]
	while pod_i < def.pods.size() and wave_t >= float(def.pods[pod_i].t):
		var pod: Dictionary = def.pods[pod_i]
		pod_i += 1
		_spawn_pod(pod)


func _spawn_pod(pod: Dictionary) -> void:
	var lane: String = pod.lane
	var gate: Vector3 = info.gates[lane]
	var route: Array = info.routes[lane]
	for kind: String in pod.comp:
		var d := DummyEnemy.make(world,
				gate + Vector3(rng.randf_range(-1.5, 1.5), 0, rng.randf_range(0, 1.5)),
				kind, core, PackedVector3Array(route))
		d.last_hit_source = ActorIface.Source.OTHER
		d.health.destroyed.connect(func(_e: Dictionary) -> void: pass)
		_track(d)
		_kpi.spawned += 1
	# GREEDY density: +1 pressure per pod while greedy (the risk's teeth).
	if greedy:
		var dx := DummyEnemy.make(world,
				gate + Vector3(rng.randf_range(-1.5, 1.5), 0, 1.0),
				"pressure", core, PackedVector3Array(route))
		_track(dx)
		_kpi.spawned += 1


func _track(d: DummyEnemy) -> void:
	_tracked.append(d)
	d.died.connect(func(_e: DummyEnemy) -> void:
		var src_name: String = ActorIface.Source.keys()[clampi(d.last_hit_source,
				0, ActorIface.Source.size() - 1)].to_lower()
		_kpi_kills[src_name] = int(_kpi_kills.get(src_name, 0)) + 1
		_kpi_leaked += 1 if d.reached_core else 0)

extends RefCounted
## Shared vocabulary for the mission kernel. Plain strings so events serialize
## to telemetry/JSON without name() lookups.

# --- Phases ---------------------------------------------------------------
const BOOT := "BOOT"
const SCOUT := "SCOUT"
const ASSAULT := "ASSAULT"
const INTERMISSION := "INTERMISSION"
const WITHDRAWAL := "WITHDRAWAL"
const CONCLUDED := "CONCLUDED"

# --- Pressure dimensions (data hooks a risk profile may touch) ------------
const DIM_SPAWN_CADENCE := "SPAWN_CADENCE"      # mul: compress/stretch spawn offsets
const DIM_SPAWN_COUNT := "SPAWN_COUNT"          # mul: scale batch counts
const DIM_LANES := "LANES"                      # add_lane: force lane open
const DIM_ROLE_WEIGHT := "ROLE_WEIGHT"          # mul + role: scale one role's counts
const DIM_AGGRESSION := "AGGRESSION"            # mul: enemy behavior budget passed in intent
const DIM_HARASSER_CHANCE := "HARASSER_CHANCE"  # add: prob per batch of harasser escort
const DIM_INTEL_QUALITY := "INTEL_QUALITY"      # mul: threat preview fidelity
const DIM_HAZARD_RATE := "HAZARD_RATE"          # mul: hazard schedule density

# --- Commands -------------------------------------------------------------
const CMD_CONFIGURE := "CONFIGURE_MISSION"
const CMD_START_WAVE := "START_WAVE"
const CMD_SET_RISK := "SET_RISK"
const CMD_REQUEST_WITHDRAWAL := "REQUEST_WITHDRAWAL"
const CMD_ADVANCE := "ADVANCE"

extends Node3D

## VS-2 net world (merge wave step 2): the minimal authoritative scene
## Host + Client(s) + Player avatars + Core + dummy enemy + packed crowd.
## Ported from lab/vs2-netcode boot orchestration onto skeleton primitives:
## Session statics for config, Net for transport ownership, Log for output.
##
## Mounted by boot.gd as WORLD for HOST/CLIENT modes; NORMAL solo stays on
## main.tscn. Gameplay rules arrive in later waves — this proves the seam.

const CROWD_COUNT_DEFAULT := 64
const DUMMY_POS := Vector3(6, 0, -4)

var metrics := MetricsCollector.new()
var crowd: CrowdStream = null
var core: CoreObject = null
var operation: OperationShell = null
var mission_runtime: OperationRuntime = null
var defense_runtime: OperationDefenseRuntime = null
var mech_runtime: OperationMechRuntime = null
var threat_runtime: OperationThreatRuntime = null
var presentation_adapter: OperationPresentationAdapter = null
var operation_hud: OperationHud = null
var players_root: Node3D = null
var seen_fire_seqs := {}
var _is_host := false


func _ready() -> void:
	_is_host = Net.is_server()
	var role := "host" if _is_host else "client"
	metrics.setup(role)
	Log.network("net session role=%s peer=%d" % [role, Net.local_peer_id()])
	# VS-2 lifecycle surface: graceful leave N seconds after mount (drives
	# join/leave/reconnect orchestrators). Scene-tree timer — survives here,
	# unlike node timers racing change_scene.
	if not _is_host and Session.leave_after_sec > 0.0:
		get_tree().create_timer(Session.leave_after_sec).timeout.connect(_graceful_leave)
	if _is_host and Session.quit_after_sec > 0.0:
		get_tree().create_timer(Session.quit_after_sec).timeout.connect(func():
			Log.network("host bench window over")
			metrics.dump("user://logs/metrics_host.json")
			get_tree().quit(0))
	elif not _is_host and Session.quit_after_sec > 0.0 and Session.leave_after_sec <= 0.0:
		get_tree().create_timer(Session.quit_after_sec).timeout.connect(func():
			metrics.dump("user://logs/metrics_client.json")
			get_tree().quit(0))
	_build_world()

	if _is_host:
		multiplayer.peer_connected.connect(_on_peer_joined)
		multiplayer.peer_disconnected.connect(_on_peer_left)
		crowd = _spawn_crowd()
		_mount_operation_runtime()
		var dummy := NetDummyEnemy.new()
		dummy.name = "NetDummyEnemy"
		dummy.position = DUMMY_POS
		add_child(dummy)
		NetworkTime.after_tick.connect(_on_host_tick)
		_ensure_avatar(1, true)
	else:
		multiplayer.peer_connected.connect(_on_peer_joined)
		multiplayer.connected_to_server.connect(_on_client_connected)
		multiplayer.server_disconnected.connect(_on_server_disconnected)


func _build_world() -> void:
	# VS-7A: host and clients mount the exact same authored operation shell.
	# OperationLayout is now the production SSOT for geometry + semantic POIs.
	operation = OperationShell.new()
	operation.name = "Operation"
	add_child(operation)

	var cam := Camera3D.new()
	cam.position = Vector3(38, 42, 50)
	add_child(cam)
	cam.look_at(OperationLayout.pois().core, Vector3.UP)

	var sun := DirectionalLight3D.new()
	sun.rotation_degrees = Vector3(-55, 35, 0)
	sun.shadow_enabled = true
	add_child(sun)

	core = CoreObject.new()
	core.name = "Core"
	core.position = OperationLayout.pois().core
	add_child(core)

	players_root = Node3D.new()
	players_root.name = "Players"
	add_child(players_root)


func _spawn_crowd() -> CrowdStream:
	var c := CrowdStream.new()
	c.name = "Crowd"
	c.setup(Session.crowd_count, metrics)
	c.ladder_print = Session.ladder_print
	if Session.crowd_sim and _is_host:
		c.enable_sim(Session.seed_value, not Session.operation_mode)
	c.core = core
	add_child(c)
	return c


func _mount_operation_runtime() -> void:
	if mission_runtime != null or crowd == null:
		return
	if not Session.operation_mode:
		return
	# Only the authoritative host simulates enemies. Clients mount the same
	# OperationRuntime NodePath so state/event RPCs resolve deterministically.
	if _is_host and not crowd.sim_mode:
		push_error("operation mode requires authoritative CrowdSim")
		return

	mission_runtime = OperationRuntime.new()
	mission_runtime.name = "OperationRuntime"
	add_child(mission_runtime)
	mission_runtime.setup(operation, crowd, core, players_root)

	defense_runtime = OperationDefenseRuntime.new()
	defense_runtime.name = "DefenseRuntime"
	add_child(defense_runtime)
	defense_runtime.setup(crowd, players_root, mission_runtime.mission_config(), mission_runtime)
	mission_runtime.mission_event.connect(defense_runtime.on_mission_event)

	mech_runtime = OperationMechRuntime.new()
	mech_runtime.name = "MechRuntime"
	add_child(mech_runtime)
	mech_runtime.setup(crowd, players_root, mission_runtime)

	threat_runtime = OperationThreatRuntime.new()
	threat_runtime.name = "ThreatRuntime"
	add_child(threat_runtime)
	threat_runtime.setup(crowd, players_root, mech_runtime, mission_runtime)

	presentation_adapter = OperationPresentationAdapter.new()
	presentation_adapter.name = "PresentationAdapter"
	add_child(presentation_adapter)
	presentation_adapter.setup(mission_runtime, crowd, defense_runtime, mech_runtime, players_root)

	if _is_host:
		defense_runtime.ammo_spent.connect(mission_runtime.report_ammo_spent)
		defense_runtime.resupply_received.connect(mission_runtime.report_resupply)
		defense_runtime.supply_trip.connect(mission_runtime.report_supply_trip)
		defense_runtime.asset_lost.connect(mission_runtime.report_asset_lost)
		mech_runtime.asset_lost.connect(mission_runtime.report_asset_lost)
		mech_runtime.metric.connect(mission_runtime.report_metric)
		defense_runtime.threat_cue.connect(func(cue): mission_runtime.report_presentation_event(
			str(cue.get("kind","world_cue")), cue))
		mech_runtime.threat_cue.connect(func(cue): mission_runtime.report_presentation_event(
			str(cue.get("kind","world_cue")), cue))
		threat_runtime.threat_cue.connect(func(cue): mission_runtime.report_presentation_event(
			str(cue.get("kind","world_cue")), cue))
		mission_runtime.register_asset("MG_A", "TURRET_MG")
		mission_runtime.register_asset("CC_B", "TURRET_CC")
		mission_runtime.register_asset("SUPPLY_MAIN", "SUPPLY")
		mission_runtime.register_asset("MECH_01", "MECH")

	operation_hud = OperationHud.new()
	operation_hud.name = "OperationHud"
	add_child(operation_hud)
	operation_hud.setup(presentation_adapter)


func _on_peer_joined(id: int) -> void:
	Log.network("peer_joined:%d" % id)
	_ensure_avatar(id, false)


func _on_peer_left(id: int) -> void:
	Log.network("peer_left:%d" % id)
	if defense_runtime != null and _is_host:
		defense_runtime.on_peer_left(id)
	if mech_runtime != null and _is_host:
		mech_runtime.on_peer_left(id)
	var p := players_root.get_node_or_null("Player_%d" % id)
	if p != null:
		p.queue_free()
	seen_fire_seqs.erase(id)


func _on_client_connected() -> void:
	Log.network("connected_to_server")
	_ensure_avatar(Net.local_peer_id(), true)
	if crowd == null:
		crowd = _spawn_crowd()
	_mount_operation_runtime()
	var dummy := NetDummyEnemy.new()
	dummy.name = "NetDummyEnemy"
	dummy.position = DUMMY_POS
	add_child(dummy)


func _on_server_disconnected() -> void:
	Log.network("server_disconnected")


func _graceful_leave() -> void:
	Log.network("graceful leave after %.1fs" % Session.leave_after_sec)
	Net.shutdown()
	get_tree().quit(0)


func _ensure_avatar(peer: int, is_local: bool) -> void:
	if players_root.has_node("Player_%d" % peer):
		return
	var p := PlayerAvatar.new()
	p.set_multiplayer_authority(1, false) # state owner = host; PilotInput keeps player authority
	p.setup(peer, is_local)
	p.metrics = metrics
	if Session.operation_mode and is_local:
		p.drive_mode = "input"
	p.position = OperationLayout.player_spawn(peer)
	p.face_world_point(OperationLayout.pois().core)

	var rs := RollbackSynchronizer.new()
	rs.name = "RollbackSync"
	rs.root = p
	rs.enable_prediction = true
	rs.state_properties = [":position", ":rotation", ":velocity", ":grounded", ":hp", ":downed", ":respawn_left", ":embarked", ":last_jump_seq"]
	rs.input_properties = ["PilotInput:move", "PilotInput:look_yaw", "PilotInput:look_pitch", "PilotInput:fire_seq", "PilotInput:jump_seq", "PilotInput:aiming"]
	rs.enable_input_broadcast = false
	p.add_child(rs)

	var ti := TickInterpolator.new()
	ti.name = "TickInterp"
	ti.root = p
	ti.properties = [":position"]
	p.add_child(ti)

	players_root.add_child(p)


func _on_host_tick(_dt: float, _tick: int) -> void:
	if crowd != null:
		crowd.host_step(NetworkTime.ticktime)
	# Pure CrowdSim ladder measures crowd/network capacity, not combat balance.
	# Keep avatars/netfox alive so the network seam is still exercised, but do
	# not let the synthetic pilot delete measured agents. Playable --operation
	# never satisfies pure_crowd_ladder(), so its combat path is unchanged.
	if not Session.pure_crowd_ladder():
		var pilot_range_mul := float(mission_runtime.hazard_value("pilot_range_mul", 1.0)) \
			if mission_runtime != null else 1.0
		for p in players_root.get_children():
			p.resolve_fire_if_new(seen_fire_seqs, "../Crowd", metrics, pilot_range_mul)
	if Engine.get_process_frames() % 30 == 0:
		metrics.net_perf_snapshot()


func _exit_tree() -> void:
	if NetworkTime.after_tick.is_connected(_on_host_tick):
		NetworkTime.after_tick.disconnect(_on_host_tick)

class_name OperationDebugHud
extends CanvasLayer

var runtime: OperationRuntime = null
var crowd: CrowdStream = null
var core: CoreObject = null
var defense: OperationDefenseRuntime = null
var mech: OperationMechRuntime = null
var adapter: OperationPresentationAdapter = null
var _label: Label = null
var _warning: Label = null
var _minimap: OperationMinimap = null
var _warning_until_ms := 0


func setup(p_runtime:OperationRuntime,p_crowd:CrowdStream,p_core:CoreObject,
		p_defense:OperationDefenseRuntime=null,p_mech:OperationMechRuntime=null,
		p_adapter:OperationPresentationAdapter=null)->void:
	runtime=p_runtime;crowd=p_crowd;core=p_core;defense=p_defense;mech=p_mech;adapter=p_adapter
	if adapter!=null:
		adapter.snapshot_changed.connect(_on_snapshot)
		adapter.gameplay_event.connect(_on_gameplay_event)
	elif runtime!=null:
		runtime.mission_state_changed.connect(func(_s):_refresh_legacy())
	_refresh_legacy()


func _ready()->void:
	_label=Label.new();_label.position=Vector2(18,18)
	_label.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size",18);add_child(_label)
	_warning=Label.new();_warning.position=Vector2(380,18)
	_warning.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size",24)
	_warning.add_theme_color_override("font_color",Color(1.0,0.55,0.18));add_child(_warning)
	_minimap=OperationMinimap.new()
	_minimap.position=Vector2(18,180);_minimap.custom_minimum_size=Vector2(230,230)
	add_child(_minimap)


func _process(_delta:float)->void:
	if _warning!=null and Time.get_ticks_msec()>_warning_until_ms:_warning.text=""


func _refresh_legacy()->void:
	if adapter!=null:_on_snapshot(adapter.snapshot())
	elif runtime!=null:_draw_state(runtime.get_state())


func _on_snapshot(snap:Dictionary)->void:
	if _minimap!=null:_minimap.update_state(snap)
	var state: Dictionary = runtime.get_state() if runtime != null else {}
	_draw_state(state,snap)


func _draw_state(state:Dictionary,snap:Dictionary={})->void:
	if _label==null:return
	if state.is_empty():
		_label.text="HARVEST OPERATION\nwaiting for authoritative mission state...";return
	var ex_mex: int = int(state.get("ex_mex",0))
	var quota_mex: int = int(state.get("quota_mex",0))
	var alive: int = crowd.enemy_count() if crowd != null else 0
	var hp:=core.core_hp if core!=null else int(state.get("core_hp",0))
	var defense_line: String = "MG -- | CC --"
	var supply_line: String = "SUPPLY --"
	var pack_line: String = ""
	if defense!=null:
		var ds: Dictionary = defense.get_state()
		var parts: Array[String] = []
		for t in ds.get("turrets",[]):
			parts.append("%s@%s %s %d/%d"%[str(t.get("kind","?")),str(t.get("socket_id","?")),
				"X" if bool(t.get("destroyed",false)) else "HP%d%%"%int(
				100.0*float(t.get("hp",0.0))/maxf(float(t.get("hp_max",1.0)),1.0)),
				int(t.get("ammo",0)),int(t.get("ammo_max",0))])
		if not parts.is_empty():defense_line=" | ".join(parts)
		var supply:Dictionary=ds.get("supply",{})
		supply_line="SUPPLY %s reserve %d"%[
			"DESTROYED" if bool(supply.get("destroyed",false)) else "OK",int(supply.get("reserve",0))]
		var peer: int = multiplayer.get_unique_id() if multiplayer.multiplayer_peer != null else 1
		var carried:=int(ds.get("packs",{}).get(peer,0))
		if carried>0:pack_line=" | CARRY AMMO %d"%carried
		var moving:=str(ds.get("carried_turrets",{}).get(peer,""))
		if moving!="":pack_line+=" | MOVE %s"%moving
	var mech_line:="MECH --"
	if mech!=null:
		var ms:=mech.get_state()
		if not ms.is_empty():mech_line="MECH HP%d%% driver=%d heat=%d rkt=%d"%[
			int(float(ms.get("hp_frac",0.0))*100.0),int(ms.get("driver_peer",0)),
			int(float(ms.get("heat",0.0))),int(ms.get("rockets",0))]
	var preview:Dictionary=state.get("threat_preview",{})
	var next_line:="NEXT --"
	if not preview.is_empty():
		next_line="NEXT lanes=%s roles=%s intel=%s"%[
			str(preview.get("lanes",[])),str(preview.get("roles_estimated",{})),
			str(preview.get("intel_detail","?"))]
	var hazard:=str(state.get("active_hazard",""))
	var extract_hint:="EXTRACT locked"
	if bool(state.get("quota_met",false)):
		extract_hint="EXTRACT READY — go to pad + [E]"
	_label.text=("HARVEST — CINDER CANYON\n"+
		"phase %s | wave %d/%d | risk %s | hazard %s\n"%[
			str(state.get("phase","?")),int(state.get("current_wave_index",0)),
			int(state.get("waves_total",0)),str(state.get("risk_id","?")),hazard if hazard!="" else "none"]+
		"Core %d | EX %.1f / %.1f | crowd %d\n"%[hp,ex_mex/1000.0,quota_mex/1000.0,alive]+
		"%s\n%s%s\n%s\n%s\n%s\n"%[next_line,defense_line,pack_line,supply_line,mech_line,extract_hint]+
		"ENTER wave  G SAFE/GREEDY  E extract  F ammo  R relocate  M mech(host)")


func _on_gameplay_event(ename:StringName,payload:Dictionary)->void:
	if _warning==null:return
	match String(ename):
		"harasser_lock":
			_warning.text="HARASSER LOCK → %s"%str(payload.get("target","INFRA"))
		"harasser_strike":
			_warning.text="HARASSER STRIKE → %s"%str(payload.get("target","INFRA"))
		"pilot_hit":
			_warning.text="PILOT HIT — %s"%str(payload.get("source_role","ENEMY"))
		"pilot_down":
			_warning.text="PILOT DOWN"
		"mech_hit":
			_warning.text="MECH HIT — %s"%str(payload.get("source_role","ENEMY"))
		"hazard_started":
			_warning.text=str(payload.get("hazard_id","HAZARD")).replace("_"," ")
		"relocate_denied":
			_warning.text="TURRET MOVE — INTERWAVE ONLY"
		"extraction_denied":
			_warning.text="EXTRACTION — REACH PAD"
		"quota_met":
			_warning.text="CONTRACT READY — EXTRACT OR CONTINUE"
		_:
			return
	_warning_until_ms=Time.get_ticks_msec()+3200

		[Vector3(-FIELD_HALF - 4, 4, 0), Vector3(8, 8, FIELD_SIZE + 16)],
	]:
		out.append({"name": "border", "kind": "rock", "pos": item[0], "size": item[1]})

	# Canyon perimeter: authored openings remain free for A/B/C.
	for item in [
		[Vector3(-60, 3, -60), Vector3(16, 6, 16)],
		[Vector3(0, 3, -64), Vector3(30, 6, 10)],
		[Vector3(62, 3, -58), Vector3(16, 6, 16)],
		[Vector3(-64, 3, 0), Vector3(10, 6, 30)],
		[Vector3(64, 3, 0), Vector3(10, 6, 30)],
		[Vector3(-58, 3, 58), Vector3(20, 6, 20)],
		[Vector3(58, 3, 58), Vector3(20, 6, 20)],
		[Vector3(-26, 3, 54), Vector3(24, 6, 10)],
		[Vector3(26, 3, 54), Vector3(24, 6, 10)],
	]:
		out.append({"name": "canyon", "kind": "rock", "pos": item[0], "size": item[1]})

	# Rig / objective cluster. Crowd nav clears a disc around the goal after rasterization.
	out.append({"name": "rig_base", "kind": "core", "pos": Vector3(0, 2.5, 0), "size": Vector3(10, 5, 10)})
	out.append({"name": "rig_column", "kind": "core", "pos": Vector3(0, 10, 0), "size": Vector3(4, 10, 4), "tags": ["nav_ignore"]})
	out.append({"name": "rig_head", "kind": "core", "pos": Vector3(0, 16, 0), "size": Vector3(7, 2, 7), "tags": ["nav_ignore"]})
	out.append({"name": "tether", "kind": "ex", "pos": Vector3(0, 21.5, 0), "size": Vector3(1.2, 9, 1.2), "tags": ["nav_ignore"]})
	out.append({"name": "platform", "kind": "platform", "pos": Vector3(5, 25.5, -2), "size": Vector3(26, 3, 20), "tags": ["nav_ignore"]})

	# Core ring with authored gaps.
	for item in [
		["ring_N", Vector3(0, 0.7, -11), Vector3(12, 1.4, 1)],
		["ring_E", Vector3(11, 0.7, 0), Vector3(1, 1.4, 12)],
		["ring_W", Vector3(-11, 0.7, 0), Vector3(1, 1.4, 12)],
		["ring_S_W", Vector3(-7, 0.7, 11), Vector3(4, 1.4, 1)],
		["ring_S_E", Vector3(7, 0.7, 11), Vector3(4, 1.4, 1)],
		["ring_SW", Vector3(-8.5, 0.7, 8.5), Vector3(5, 1.4, 5)],
		["ring_SE", Vector3(8.5, 0.7, 8.5), Vector3(5, 1.4, 5)],
	]:
		out.append({
			"name": item[0], "kind": "ring", "pos": item[1], "size": item[2],
			# 2 m crowd cells quantize the physical 0.6 m agent radius too
			# conservatively here and close the authored NW/NE access gaps.
			"nav_padding": CORE_RING_NAV_PADDING,
		})

	# Lane A — doctrine / long L.
	for item in [
		["wall_A_N", Vector3(-30, 1.5, -15.5), Vector3(28, 3, 3)],
		["wall_A_S", Vector3(-30, 1.5, -2.5), Vector3(28, 3, 3)],
		["wall_A_E", Vector3(-38.5, 1.5, -35), Vector3(3, 3, 38)],
		["wall_A_W", Vector3(-53.5, 1.5, -35), Vector3(3, 3, 38)],
	]:
		out.append({"name": item[0], "kind": "wall_A", "pos": item[1], "size": item[2]})

	# Lane B — intervention dogleg + pinch.
	for item in [
		["wall_B_W", Vector3(6.5, 1.5, -24.5), Vector3(3, 3, 23)],
		["wall_B_E", Vector3(19.5, 1.5, -24.5), Vector3(3, 3, 23)],
		["pinch_W", Vector3(9.25, 1.75, -20), Vector3(2.5, 3.5, 4)],
		["pinch_E", Vector3(16.75, 1.75, -20), Vector3(2.5, 3.5, 4)],
		["wall_B_S", Vector3(35, 1.5, -32.5), Vector3(34, 3, 3)],
		["wall_B_N", Vector3(35, 1.5, -47.5), Vector3(34, 3, 3)],
	]:
		out.append({"name": item[0], "kind": "wall_B", "pos": item[1], "size": item[2]})

	# Lane C — sealed until breakdown/breach.
	out.append({"name": "stem_wall_W", "kind": "wall_C", "pos": Vector3(-7.5, 2.5, 28), "size": Vector3(3, 5, 36)})
	out.append({"name": "stem_wall_E", "kind": "wall_C", "pos": Vector3(7.5, 2.5, 28), "size": Vector3(3, 5, 36)})
	out.append({"name": "bulkhead", "kind": "bulkhead", "pos": Vector3(0, 3, 32), "size": Vector3(16, 6, 4)})
	out.append({"name": "pocket_cap", "kind": "wall_C", "pos": Vector3(0, 2.5, 44), "size": Vector3(18, 5, 2)})
	out.append({"name": "spoil_W", "kind": "rock", "pos": Vector3(-13, 2.5, 21), "size": Vector3(8, 5, 12)})
	out.append({"name": "spoil_E", "kind": "rock", "pos": Vector3(13, 2.5, 21), "size": Vector3(8, 5, 12)})

	# Gameplay landmarks / cover.
	out.append({"name": "terrace_NW", "kind": "rock", "pos": Vector3(-24, 2, -25), "size": Vector3(12, 4, 10)})
	out.append({"name": "terrace_E", "kind": "rock", "pos": Vector3(26, 1.5, 8), "size": Vector3(10, 3, 8)})
	out.append({"name": "perch_W", "kind": "perch", "pos": Vector3(-44, 3.5, 10), "size": Vector3(3, 7, 3)})
	out.append({"name": "perch_E", "kind": "perch", "pos": Vector3(30, 3.5, -24), "size": Vector3(3, 7, 3)})
	out.append({"name": "supply_cover", "kind": "supply", "pos": Vector3(-24, 1.3, -2), "size": Vector3(6, 2.6, 2.4)})
	out.append({"name": "extract_cover", "kind": "extract", "pos": Vector3(8, 1.3, 5.5), "size": Vector3(2.4, 2.6, 8)})
	return out


static func markers() -> Array:
	var p := pois()
	var out: Array = [
		{"name": "spawn_A", "kind": "spawn_A", "pos": p.spawn_A, "size": Vector2(14, 8)},
		{"name": "spawn_B", "kind": "spawn_B", "pos": p.spawn_B, "size": Vector2(8, 12)},
		{"name": "spawn_C", "kind": "spawn_C", "pos": p.spawn_C, "size": Vector2(10, 8)},
		{"name": "mech_drop", "kind": "mech", "pos": p.mech_drop, "size": Vector2(8, 6)},
		{"name": "extract", "kind": "extract", "pos": p.extraction_pad, "size": Vector2(12, 8)},
		{"name": "supply", "kind": "supply", "pos": p.supply_point, "size": Vector2(7, 7)},
	]
	for socket in sockets():
		out.append({"name": socket.id, "kind": "socket", "pos": socket.pos, "size": Vector2(3, 3)})
	return out


static func nav_blockers(lane_c_open: bool = false) -> Array:
	var out: Array = []
	for blocker in blockers():
		var tags: Array = blocker.get("tags", [])
		if tags.has("nav_ignore"):
			continue
		if lane_c_open and blocker.name == "bulkhead":
			continue
		# Ignore overhead geometry for the ground crowd.
		var bottom := float(blocker.pos.y) - float(blocker.size.y) * 0.5
		if bottom > 2.2:
			continue
		out.append(blocker)
	return out
